summary: Cuentas Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an Amended and Restated Warrant Agency Agreement, extending the expiration of its publicly traded warrants from September 30, 2026 to December 31, 2026, with the Board also authorized to reduce the exercise price and proportionately increase warrant shares. The warrants were issued in a February 2021 unit offering, initially exercisable at $4.30 before a one-for-thirteen reverse split raised the strike to $55.90. The company has applied to list on OTCQB and is restructuring via a World Mobile joint venture. This is a routine modification of security holder rights, not a special situation.
